rows.label: Concept
rows.text: **Electric flux** through area A in field E is $\Phi = EA\cos\theta$ (N m²C⁻¹) — the field-line count through a surface. **Gauss's law** states that the total flux through any closed surface equals $q_{enclosed}/\varepsilon_0$ (NEB 2023, 2024, 5m).…

rows.label: Formula
rows.text: - Φ = EA cos θ - ∮E·dA = q_enc/ε₀ - E_sheet = σ/2ε₀

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: **Enclosed charge only:** outside charges' flux enters and leaves — net contribution zero.  ·  **Pillbox has two faces:** E = σ/2ε₀, not σ/ε₀.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: If a closed surface encloses an electric dipole (charges +q and -q), the net flux through the surface is identically zero because Q_enc = +q - q = 0.  ·  For an area vector of a closed surface, dA points outward by standard mathematical convention, so exiting flux is positive and entering flux is negative.

rows.label: Limitation
rows.text: Covers only: gauss law, electric flux (within Electric Field).  ·  Out of scope here: topics of neighbouring units in Physics — don't mix them.

rows.label: Derivation
rows.text: Prove Gauss's Law for a spherical surface enclosing a point charge.  ·  Calculate flux through individual faces of a cube with charges at the center, corner, or edge.

rows.label: Board question
rows.text: **Numerical (2m): Flux through a closed surface enclosing −3 μC.** — Φ = q/ε₀ = −3×10⁻⁶/8.85×10⁻¹² ≈ −3.39×10⁵ N m²C⁻¹ (negative sign: net inward flux).

rows.label: Hints
rows.text: Draw the pillbox and label both faces — diagram marks are real.

rows.label: Quick concepts
rows.text: **Gauss's law converts symmetry into answers** — sphere, line, sheet each give E in one line.

rows.label: Universal facts
rows.text: Gauss's law is one of Maxwell's four equations — the classical theory of electromagnetism rests on it.

rows.label: Study notes
rows.text: ## 1. Topic Introduction — Counting Field Lines Through a Surface Gauss's law links the electric flux through any closed surface to the charge it encloses. With symmetry — a sphere, a line, a sheet — it turns hard integrations into one-line answers. NEB 2023 and 2024 both carried it as a 5-mark question.  ·  ## 2. Fundamental Concepts (NEB 2023, 2024) ### 2.1 Electric flux **Electric flux** through an area A in a uniform field E: $$\Phi = EA\cos\theta = \vec{E}\cdot\vec{A} \qquad \text{unit: N m}^2\text{C}^{-1}$$ θ is the angle between E and the area's normal. Flux measures "how many field lines pierce" the surface.…  ·  ## 3. Conceptual Relationships - **To Topic 87:** flux counts field lines through a surface. - **To Topic 89:** the sphere, line and sheet results are Gauss's law's standard applications. - **To conductors:** zero field inside a conductor follows immediately from Gauss's law.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: Verified PYQs: Gauss's law + plane sheet (2023, 2024 — 5m each).  ·  "The total electric flux through any closed surface is equal to 1/ε₀ times the net charge enclosed by the surface."  ·  Why does a charge outside a closed box contribute zero net flux?
